Subject: Post-call recap & next steps — POC kickoff

Hi Alex / Samantha —

Thanks for taking the time today to walk through Acme's evaluation goals. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Primary POC goals: validate retrieval+reranking pipeline for support search (latency under 400ms p95, reranking improves MRR by >10%).
- Scope: seed dataset (10k tickets), two endpoints (embedding + generation), initial integration with Acme's search infra.
- Success criteria: baseline eval (current search) vs Redwood-powered reranker on your held-out set; concrete KPIs in the attached doc.
- Timeline: 4-week POC starting 6/15 with weekly syncs.
- Ownership: Marissa (acct lead), Dev (integration/infra), Michael (SLA/perf).

Action items:
1) Alex — confirm dataset access & SFTP credentials by Fri 6/12.
2) Marissa/Dev — share updated MAP and success criteria by Mon 6/15.
3) Both teams — weekly syncs on Wednesdays, 10am PT starting 6/17.

Attaching the initial success criteria doc for your review (POC-Success-Criteria-v1.pdf).

Best,
Marissa

- We can provide a 10k ticket export and a held-out eval set by EOD Friday (6/12).

If that sounds reasonable, we can detail the extra requirements in a follow-up note.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Zhao <alex.zhao@acme.com>, Samantha Li <samantha.li@acme.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Updated POC plan & re-baseline (includes reranking use case)

Hi Alex / Samantha —

Thanks for confirming the dataset — we received the export and the held-out eval set. Per our internal review and Dev's estimate, we can include the reranking use case but need to re-baseline the success criteria and timeline slightly. Summary of changes (see attached MAP):

- New scope: add "post-filter reranking" use case that applies Acme business rules before reranking.
- Success criteria (updated):
  - Latency: target end-to-end p95 <= 450ms (adjusted from 400ms) when rule engine is simple (avg rule eval < 30ms). If rules are complex and avg eval > 60ms, we'll treat as out-of-scope for the 4-week POC and recommend follow-on work.
  - Quality: reranker improves MRR by >=8% vs baseline for the reranking-specific traffic segment (previously 10% across whole set).
  - Integration: data ingestion and eval pipeline validated, and end-to-end demo with Acme infra.
- Timeline: POC extended to 5 weeks, new end date 7/20; weekly syncs remain and we'll add a mid-POC checkpoint on 6/29 to verify rule performance.
- Ownership: Marissa (acct/coord), Dev (integration), Michael (perf/SLO), Rachel (CS lead - success criteria validation and acceptance testing).

Action items now:
1) Acme -> share business-rule spec + sample rules by Fri 6/19.
2) Redwood -> deliver updated MAP + test plan by Mon 6/22 (attached MAP-20260620.xlsx).
3) Both -> join mid-POC checkpoint 6/29.

Attachment: POC-Success-Criteria-v2.pdf, MAP-20260620.xlsx

Please reply with any objections to the adjusted criteria or timeline by EOD 6/18 so we can lock the plan.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
